description: Fersa Bearings and IES used the STREAM-0D project to develop simulation-based control for a bearing production line in Spain. The case describes multi-physics models using online measurements to predict product-quality indicators and adjust production. A customised iSCAN system collected and analysed signals from 129 sensors at one-second resolution and displayed ten selected metrics. The narrative links this work to defect detection and production flexibility. The sensor streams, predictive models and control software are described but were not obtained. Awards reported for 2019 and 2020 do not specify the full study period. This public HTML case narrative is published by IES and can be read without payment. Its reuse licence is not stated. Access to the described software, input data and project models is not established by the public page. The source does not give a complete study period or all spatial and temporal model resolutions. Reported results are provider claims and have not been independently reproduced. The case supports the documented infrastructure simulation use and is linked to the named modelling resources. Only metadata and the case description were inspected; no data or model files were downloaded.
